svg.text: INSTRUCTIONAL MOCKUP — NOT A LIVE CAPTURE OR RESULT
Verify the certificate and private key match
Application server (TLS-APP01) · RHEL 9 Bash terminal · learner@10.90.0.10
COMMAND / FILE CONTENT TO ENTER — PRESERVE CASE
openssl x509 -in ~/tls-work/app-v1.crt -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER | openssl
sudo openssl pkey -in /etc/pki/tls/private/app-v1.key -pubout -outform DER | openssl dgst -sha256
EXPECTED RESULT / SIMULATED CLUE — CHECK YOUR OWN MACHINE
Two SHA-256 digests are identical. Your real values are random and will not match a picture.
FOLLOW THE NUMBERED INSTRUCTIONS IN THE LESSON
1. Paste the complete block below. set -o pipefail prevents a pipeline from hiding a failed earlier
2. The first SHA-256 line comes from the certificate’s public key. The second comes from only the public
3. Both commands must succeed and the complete digests must match exactly. These are public-key digests,
not hashes of the certificate file bytes.
No real private key, real certificate result, production access or DoD endorsement is shown.
